name: Circle of the Shepherd
description: A legacy druid subclass from Xanathar's Guide to Everything.

grants.name: Speech of the Woods
grants.description: Speak, read, and write Sylvan. Beasts understand your speech, and you can interpret their noises and movements well enough to exchange simple recent information; this does not make them friendly.

grants.name: Spirit Totem
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, summon a Bear, Hawk, or Unicorn spirit at a visible point within 60 feet for 1 minute, creating a 30-foot aura; move it 60 feet with another Bonus Action. Bear grants 5 + Druid level Temporary Hit Points on arrival and Strength advantage; Hawk grants Perception advantage and can use your reaction to grant an attack advantage; Unicorn grants detection advantage and heals chosen creatures in the aura for your Druid level when your slotted spell restores Hit Points. Regain use after a Short or Long Rest.

grants.name: Mighty Summoner
grants.description: Beasts and Fey summoned or created by your spells gain 2 extra Hit Points per Hit Die, and their natural-weapon damage counts as magical against resistance and immunity.

grants.name: Guardian Spirit
grants.description: A Beast or Fey summoned or created by your spell regains Hit Points equal to half your Druid level whenever it ends its turn inside your Spirit Totem aura.

grants.name: Faithful Summons
grants.description: When unwillingly reduced to 0 Hit Points or Incapacitated, immediately gain a 9th-level Conjure Animals effect without Concentration: four chosen Beasts of CR 2 or lower appear within 20 feet for 1 hour and defend you. Regain use after a Long Rest.
